classTokenJoiner

Grammarpackages/sql-faker/src/Grammar/Lexical/TokenJoiner.php:16
final class TokenJoiner
Restricted visibility: declared "@visibility root". Code outside that scope must not name this declaration.

Joins SQL tokens into a string with correct spacing.

Shared across all SQL generators. Handles common spacing rules (parentheses, dots, brackets, commas) while supporting dialect-specific no-space pairs.

Methods§

public static function join(
    list<string> $tokens,
    list<list<string>> $noSpacePairs = [],
    callable(): string|null $separator = null,
    callable(): string|null $optionalTrivia = null,
): string
100%source§

Parameters

$tokenslist<string>SQL tokens to join
$noSpacePairslist<list<string>>Additional [prev, token] pairs that need no space. Use '*' as wildcard for either position.
$separatorcallable(): string|nullGenerates trivia for boundaries that require separation.
$optionalTriviacallable(): string|nullGenerates optional trivia at the outer and compact boundaries.

Returns

string

public static function matchesNoSpacePair(
    list<list<string>> $noSpacePairs,
    string|null $prev,
    string $token,
): bool
100%source§

Reports whether two adjacent tokens are named by a pair that forbids a space.

A pair may name a wildcard on either side, so a dialect can say "never

* after an opening parenthesis" without listing what may follow it.

Parameters

$noSpacePairslist<list<string>>Pairs of tokens that must be written together
$prevstring|nullToken already written, or null at the start
$tokenstringToken about to be written

Returns

bool True when nothing may be written between them

public static function isQuotedIdentifier(string $token): bool
100%source§

Reports whether a token is an identifier written inside quotes.

A quoted identifier carries its own boundaries, so it never needs a space between itself and what comes next.

Parameters

$tokenstringToken to judge

Returns

bool True when the token opens and closes with the same quote
